name: Hans Rabl
reason: The Landratsamt's Jahresbilanz 2019 reports that Hans Rabl, 'Träger der Verdienstmedaille des Verdienstordens', died on 7 September 2019; 2019 is the year of his death, not of the award, which no list since 2015 contains. Matthias Stegmeir's 2019 Verdienstmedaille on the same page remains.

name: Aloysius Lögering
reason: Superseded entry: the January 2017 notice and its WikiProjekt copy list Aloysius Lögering (Osnabrück) with the Verdienstmedaille, the BPR January page as archived in September 2017 lists him under Verdienstkreuz am Bande, and the March 2017 lists (BPR, Bundesanzeiger, WikiProjekt) announce him again with the Verdienstkreuz am Bande. One award, corrected; not two grades in one month.

name: Ruth Weiss
reason: The writer Ruth Weiss (Q104793) was listed with the Verdienstkreuz 1. Klasse in March 2015 while living in Lüdinghausen and with the Großes Verdienstkreuz in May 2024, living in Skørping (Denmark), where the German ambassador handed it over in April 2024 (de.wikipedia). The 2024 entries carry no article link, so the move split her into two people.
